run_engine_train: run the TrainerEngine to execute a self-supervised training workflow with config and checkpoint settings
build_self_supervised_trainer: build a SelfSupervisionTrainer with config, distributed run id, checkpoint path, and hooks for SSL training
setup_distributed_training: setup distributed training environment with multiprocessing method, seeds, CUDA device, and logging
generate_training_hooks: generate training hooks using hook_generator to prepare hooks executed per replica during training
resume_training_from_checkpoint: resume training from a checkpoint path with distributed run id and checkpoint folder settings
